Hi Adam thanks for the chat this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed mutual action plan: 

Summary of needs:
- Latency: p95 ~80ms target at 224x224 inputs
- Throughput: ~300 qps peak, with burst handling
- Deployment: hybrid (cloud + on-prem partner sites)
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence required for procurement

Mutual action plan:
1) You: send a short architecture diagram (one slide) and an anonymized traffic profile (typical sequence lengths, batch sizes, percent cold starts).
2) Us (Redwood): run a small feasibility note and provide options: Hosted API pilot (fast), Dedicated GPU pool (predictable throughput), Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) with rough cost/latency estimates.
3) Technical deep-dive: 60-min session with Logan (cc'd) and one of our inference engineers target next week.

Attached: SOC2_questionnaire.pdf can you confirm and return the completed questionnaire to expedite procurement?

Proposed next steps: 1) Can you share the diagram and traffic profile by EOD Friday (6/19)? 2) If yes, I'll book the technical deep-dive for the week of 6/22 and provide an initial pilot proposal.

If that all looks right, I'll put the action items in a brief mutual action plan doc and send a HubSpot link.

Best,
